sources.citation: Luo, Yongxian. 1990. Tense and aspect in Zhuang: a study of a set of tense and aspect markers. MA thesis, Australian National University, 235 pp. (data from the author's native Fengshan dialect, adapted to standard-Zhuang transcription)
